lock_assessment.priority: Small genuine integrity fix that can proceed independently if assigned; iOS remains product priority; no other crypto expansion.
lock_assessment.api: Add an owned fs::File lock guard to Store. In Store::open, open a persistent private .store.lock read+write/create/truncate(false), Unix mode 0600; File::try_lock before reading/creating store.key or any sealed file. Keep descriptor alive until Store drops. Existing std APIs already used in session layout and storage operator lock; no Cargo/dependency/unsafe change needed.
lock_assessment.failure_policy: Fail closed on WouldBlock and unsupported/error. No PID authority, no lock-file unlink on Drop (inode split-brain), no second writer, no deleting/resetting stores. An immediate lock refusal is bounded. Do not copy operator lock fail-open fallback.

apps/crypto-worker/tests/common/mod.rs (consume Client::restart(self)->Self so Worker drops before reopen; update ten restart call sites)
